en: “I've already deleted the recording, don't worry.”
“You look quite good up close... No wonder Ayano approached you.”
“Have you gotten used to this place?”
“Thanks to you, I've been really inspired recently.”
“Oh... Nah, I don't wanna go out right now.”
“Your cooking and chocolates are so good. I always finish them.”
“I want to help you with something... Is there anything you need help with?”
“There's so much I want to tell you!”
“You can ask me for anything. Anything~”
“...Sorry, it's not a good time right now.”
“I'm feeling a bit irritable... maybe because I didn't sleep well...”
“{Me}, I want... to do some real nasty stuff with you...”
“You're the only one I'll show this to.”
“I'll wear it whenever you want me to.”
